05_development_calibration: 05  Internal calibration improves probabilities, not ranking
Fixed five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on 47 tasks with calls; one-variable sigmoid, C=1, no hyperparameter search.

Brier: 0.1235 → 0.0917; ECE: 0.1347 → 0.0674, but prior ECE is lower (0.0411). ECE alone is insufficient.
OOF AUROC: 0.8812 → 0.8479; fold-specific maps change pooled ranks. A deployed positive-slope sigmoid preserves ranking.
Sources: confidence_minimal_v1/calibration_metrics.json; internal evaluation, not an independent external test  |  As of 2026-10-20

06  New-task integration works; probability transfer is unproven
30 new tasks: 26 with calls and 4 without. With only one incorrect call, AUROC 0.9286 cannot establish stable generalization.

The rule flags 11/50 calls: the sole error plus 10 correct calls. Flagging 1/1 does not establish stable 100% detection.
At 98% call correctness, constant high scores can have low Brier. Success rates across different tasks do not prove capability gains.
